purpose: A descriptor for the wall-timeout enforcement and no-orphan check. The child sleeps beyond the wall cap. The watchdog terminates -> grace -> kills the process group, then verify_no_orphan confirms no survivor. The run is classified as timeout, no receipt is written, and the elapsed wall is approximately the cap (within the kill grace).

expected_behavior.notes: The wall cap is enforced by the process-group watchdog on every POSIX platform. verify_no_orphan walks the process table (ps on macOS/BSD, /proc on Linux) and raises ORPHAN_PROCESS_DETECTED if any process in the child's group survives the kill.

notes: sleeper.v1 is a test-only adapter (loaded only under SRL_RUNNER_TEST_ADAPTERS=1). It sleeps for 10s; the runner's wall cap is set to 1s, so the watchdog fires ~1s in and kills the group. The 10s sleep never completes.
